# PDF.js files bundled for magazine preview

- Package: `pdfjs-dist`
- Version: `4.10.38`
- Build files: `build/pdf.min.mjs` and `build/pdf.worker.min.mjs`
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@4.10.38/
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

These files are used only by the multi-page magazine PDF preview; they are served locally by PAIGAAM.
